name: 馬權威
objective: This course will introduce the mathematical principles in engineering, including following topics: Matrices, Vectors, Linear Systems, Determinants, and Matrix Eigenvalue Problems in Linear Algebra; Vector Differential and Integral Calculus; Fourier Series and Fourier Integral; and Partial Differential Equations and Boundary Value Problems.
schedule:
1	Course introduction & Review. Matrices and Vectors.  
2	Matrix Multiplication & Linear Systems of Equations. 
3	Linear Independence & Solutions of Linear Systems. 
4	Second- and Third-Order Determinants & Determinants.
5	Inverse of a Matrix & Vector Spaces.
6	In-class quiz 1. The Matrix Eigenvalue Problem & Their Applications.
7	Symmetric, Skew-Symmetric, and Orthogonal Matrices & Eigenbases.
8	Vectors in 2-Space and 3-Space & Inner Product & Vector Product.
9	Vector and Scalar Functions and Their Fields. Mid-term exam. 
10	Curves & Gradient of a Scalar Field.
11	Divergence of a Vector Field & Curl of a Vector Field.
12	Line Integrals & Path Independence of Line Integrals & Green’s Theorem in the Plane.
13	Surfaces for Surface Integrals & Surface Integrals & Triple Integrals.
14	In-class quiz 2. Fourier Series & For Arbitrary Period.
15	Even and Odd Functions in Fourier Series & Fourier Integral. 
16	Basic Concepts of PDEs & Vibrating String, Wave Equation Modelling. 
17	Solution of PDEs by Fourier Series.
18	Final exam.
scorePolicy:
Attendance 15% +
In-class quizzes 1&2 25% +
Mid-term exam 30% +
Final exam 30%
